div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Untrusted input
API reply or backup file

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1 Transport and policy
HTTPS only. The Content-Security-Policy allows
connections to the two APIs and nothing else

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2 Shape check
reject anything that is not the expected structure,
size or record count

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3 Normalise
strip tags, decode entities, accept only http(s) links,
normalise DOIs, bound lengths

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
4 Whitelist validation
copy known fields one by one into new objects:
unknown keys and __proto__ never survive

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
5 Integrity rules and atomic write
references must resolve inside the file,
one transaction: all or nothing

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
6 Escape on output
every dynamic value is HTML-escaped
when drawn, never stored pre-escaped

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
7 Browser enforcement
CSP blocks inline scripts and handlers,
external scripts, and requests to other hosts

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
8 Safe links
rel=noopener noreferrer on external links

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
